scope: mGBA 0.10.5 source mechanics plus the three committed Battle Scene OFF Timer 0=D, Audio Sample=D+1 rows and existing on-time isolated/Video dual-refill runtime receipt; no selected-row callback trace or duration claim

dPlusOneSourceMechanics.rootOrdering: mTimingSchedule orders absolute deadlines first; lower numeric priority breaks only an equal-deadline tie, and equal priorities preserve insertion order.

correctedDeadlines.timer0: At Timer 0 original deadline D, GBATimerUpdateRegister uses currentTime minus cyclesLate, so its next normal overflow is D + 1254 rather than callback-arrival time plus 1254.
correctedDeadlines.fifoDma: For each routed FIFO passing its occupancy/custom-DMA gate, GBAAudioSampleFIFO stores dma.when = currentTime minus cyclesLate = D and dma.nextCount = 4 before GBADMASchedule.
correctedDeadlines.audioSample: At Audio Sample original deadline D + 1, _sample mixes at currentTime minus cyclesLate = D + 1 and schedules only its next sample event at D + 1025.

dPlusOneSourceMechanics.immediateQueueRule: If Timer 0 at D enqueues FIFO DMA and Audio Sample remains due at D + 1, the generated GBA DMA root has deadline D and is before Audio Sample by deadline despite DMA priority 64. This is conditional on Timer FIFO gates producing work.
dPlusOneSourceMechanics.fifoRequestOrder: Timer 0 calls FIFO A then FIFO B; Emerald committed paired route maps those calls to DMA1 then DMA2.

dmaArbitration.selection: GBADMAUpdate scans DMA0 through DMA3 and replaces its choice only for a strictly earlier deadline; equal newly requested DMA1/DMA2 deadlines therefore choose DMA1.
dmaArbitration.firstEventCorrection: When a fresh DMA event enters _dmaEvent, nextCount == count resets that selected dma.when to mTimingCurrentTime before its first word is serviced.
dmaArbitration.cpuBlocking: GBADMAService sets gba.cpuBlocked, and GBAProcessEvents continues timing ticks while that flag remains set; CPU instruction execution is held at the next event until DMA work clears.
dmaArbitration.perWord: Each word adds base 2 plus first-word non-sequential or later-word sequential source/destination waitstates to selected deadline, transfers one word, decrements nextCount, updates next source/destination, and reruns GBADMAUpdate.
dmaArbitration.overdueCoalescing: After a word, every enabled pending DMA whose deadline is earlier than new selected deadline is moved forward to that deadline before arbitration resumes.
dmaArbitration.completion: Final word stores completion marker in nextCount and adds terminal +2 when either endpoint is below REGION_CART0; later DMA event clears nextCount to zero, applies repeat/IRQ rules, and reruns selection.

dPlusOneSourceMechanics.narrowZeroLateDPlusOneTransition: With Timer 0 on time at D, only fresh DMA1/DMA2 work, and no other roots, first DMA1 word moves and coalesces both DMA deadlines to D + 2; Audio Sample at D + 1 then precedes next DMA root. It is source-only conditional transition, not a LILIANA execution trace.
dPlusOneSourceMechanics.audioInterleavingBoundary: Source defines queue comparisons, corrected deadlines, and DMA state transitions, but does not turn compact selected-row before/after snapshots into callback-entry log. It cannot establish which LILIANA callbacks ran between Timer 0 entry and final aggregate edge, their host/mixer outcomes, or selected-row elapsed scheduler span.

priorRuntimeReceipt.applicabilityBoundary: Two committed windows prove fresh on-time dual DMA graph and 18-master-cycle makespan with no Audio Sample due before Timer 0; one has exact prior Video callback. They do not observe Audio Sample at D + 1 and do not supply a LILIANA Audio/DMA order or duration.

smallestRequiredRuntimeObservation.target: LILIANA encrypted-accessor ordinal 23, repeated twice fresh
smallestRequiredRuntimeObservation.captureInterval: from Timer 0 callback entry through first Audio Sample callback after it and until both DMA1/DMA2 nextCount values are zero
callbackEntryFields: event name, priority, relative scheduled deadline, scheduler current time, and cyclesLate
activeDMA, cpuBlocked, and DMA1/DMA2 nextCount plus relative deadlines
FIFO A/B word level and internalRemaining at Timer 0 entry and after interval
smallestRequiredRuntimeObservation.acceptance: Two packets must agree on contiguous Timer 0 / GBA DMA / GBA Audio Sample callback-entry sequence and scheduler span from Timer 0 entry to both DMA completions; only then may selected row receive interleaving or duration statement.
smallestRequiredRuntimeObservation.prohibitedInference: Do not borrow isolated/Video 18-cycle makespan, synthesize LILIANA order from aggregate FIFO endpoints, or wire construction-clock cost.

explicitBoundary: Three committed rows are adjacent deadlines: Audio Sample is exactly one master cycle after Timer 0, not equal-deadline priority observation.
LILIANA row records only 20-cycle instruction-edge endpoints; it is not a runtime callback trace.
Source-only zero-late D/D+1 transition is conditional and deliberately not named as LILIANA runtime order.
This receipt contains no absolute selected-row scheduler timestamp, no pixel lookup, no production import, and no construction-clock behavior.
